title: B017 sealed inactive foundation dependency split — primary source plan v1
scope_completion_definition: Complete scoped inactive foundation migration and PE compiler/template handoff only after exact wrapper/seal/down/proof artifacts are authored and independently accepted; B017 remains in_progress and not enrollment ready.

snapshot.head: 9e53d4f2edaafb627a93dfc3776c1ceb3191384a
snapshot.method: Source reads/hash/object inventory only. No SQL parser, DB, runtime, network or source mutation.

seal.worker_privileged_login: If actual worker is superuser/owner/owner-assumable or holds dangerous global privilege, ordinary runtime denial is not proved. Use a network-isolated no-worker clone for compiler feedback; shared app-connected installation remains blocked until separate credentials/ACL are proven. No broad credential rotation is performed by this foundation.

package_order.action: Author exact wrapper, deterministic seal, paired down migration and target proof harness outside repo. Preserve reviewed fragment bytes as manifest inputs, no 03 or broader 02. Independent highest reviewer examines the assembled delta; source fragment verdicts do not approve installation.

On authorized isolated nonMac disposable baseline clone, verify target/version/catalog/role identity and prove installation-privilege prerequisites before DDL. No Mac parser/migration and no production target.

One transaction, ON_ERROR_STOP and bounded lock/statement timeout: preflight absent B017 objects/roles; execute only 01v2,02av2,02b; remove runtime EXECUTE and all direct private-table privileges; remove temporary owner membership/creation privileges; assert exact final owners/ACLs/RLS/policy inventory/empty tables and unchanged flag/application state; commit only if all assertions pass.

From a separate real connection using each actual runtime login and SET ROLE context, prove table/column/sequence denial, owner-role assumption denial, zero callable B017 functions and no prepared/enforced/assignment creation. This is required to call the installed foundation sealed, not inferred from service_role alone.

Run positive fragment tests only in a disposable fixture child restored from the sealed template, with privileged operator fixtures and owner-context invocation; roll back/drop all fixtures. Test compile, behavior, concurrency, fresh auth, Unicode, replay and atomicity. Do not grant the app runtime a test exception.

Restore a second clean sealed template; compare B017 object fingerprints, zero data, ACLs, no flags/trigger additions and old app smoke evidence; exercise paired rollback on a clone. Return redacted compiler/test evidence with exact artifact/baseline/runtime SHA and target version.

Fix target compiler/semantic defects locally in a new source revision and obtain independent review. Continue credential lifecycle, member/assignment/enrollment, raw/resource adapters, 47 actual call groups and full product acceptance locally; no missing design is delegated to PE.
